paragraph_text: The Beneficiary satisfies 8 C.F.R. §204.5(h)(3)(i) by demonstrating receipt of nationally and internationally recognized awards for excellence in the field. The Beneficiary was selected as a scholar of Beijing's 'Hundred People Project,' a prestigious talent recognition program that identifies and supports exceptional academics in the region [Exhibit A1, p.2]. This selection demonstrates that the Beneficiary's scholarly work has been recognized at a regional level through a competitive process that identifies only the most promising researchers. While the specific selection criteria and scale of competition are not detailed in the provided materials, the 'Hundred People Project' designation represents a significant honor that acknowledges the Beneficiary's standing among academic peers in Beijing. Furthermore, the Beneficiary's work 'On Age' won the third prize of Outstanding Achievements in Humanities and Social Sciences of the Ministry of Education of China, demonstrating national recognition of his scholarly contributions [Exhibit A1, p.2]. This award is administered by the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China, which established it in 2009 to reward researchers who have made outstanding contributions in humanities and social sciences [Exhibit B10, p.2, p.4]. The selection process occurs every three years and involves rigorous evaluation by an award committee composed of the director and deputy directors of the Social Sciences Committee of the Ministry of Education, along with heads of relevant departments [Exhibit B10, p.4, p.5]. The award structure includes grand prizes, first prizes, second prizes, and third prizes, with the Beneficiary achieving the third prize level [Exhibit B10, p.5]. Eligible achievements include books, dissertations, research reports, and popularization achievements from all general institutions of higher education across China, making this a truly national competition [Exhibit B10, p.5]. In addition to the above, the Beneficiary received the Data Awards Data Legacy of the Year Award in 2019, recognizing his significant contributions to the big data and mobile Internet fields [Exhibit B1, p.2]. The Data Awards program is jointly launched by Umen+, Zhongguancun Big Data Industry Alliance, Tsingdata Big Data Industries Association, and China Big Data Industry Observation, representing a consortium of leading industry organizations [Exhibit B3, p.3]. The selection process involved a jury of 21 judges from dozens of authorities and industry experts and scholars including China Academy of Information and Communications Technology, Tsinghua University, and Peking University, ensuring rigorous peer evaluation [Exhibit B3, p.3]. Through professional selection models, only 28 Data individuals stood out from the competition across seven award categories, demonstrating the highly selective nature of this recognition [Exhibit B3, p.4]. The Data Legacy of the Year Award specifically honors individuals who have worked deeply in big data and mobile Internet for many years, spreading insights and experiences while educating the entire industry [Exhibit B3, p.7]. Moreover, the Beneficiary's paper titled 'Challenges Posed by the Internet to Traditional Media in the Time Dimension - A Study on the Possibility of Internet Media Usage Time Surpassing Traditional Media Usage Time' won the Excellent Paper Award at the 11th China Communication Conference [Exhibit B11, p.2]. This award was issued by the Communication Association of China through the 11th China Communication Conference Organizing Committee, representing recognition from China's premier professional association for communication studies [Exhibit B11, p.2]. The conference and award demonstrate that the Beneficiary's research has been evaluated and honored by peers in the national communication academic community. Additionally, the Beneficiary's organization, Umen+, has received multiple industry awards that reflect the caliber of his professional environment and the recognition of his work's impact, including the 2019 China Big Data Innovative Enterprises TOP 100 and the Annual Best Retailing Intelligent Data Application Award [Exhibit B4, p.4]. These awards span diverse sectors including enterprise services, big data industry applications, internet security management, and retail intelligence, demonstrating broad industry recognition [Exhibit B4, p.4]. The awards come from respected industry organizations including 36 Kr, Data Technology Industry Innovation Institute (DTiii), Chaoyang Public Security Branch Network Security Guarding Brigade, and The 14th Shanghai Retail Industry Summit, indicating validation from multiple authoritative sources [Exhibit B4, p.4]. In sum, the foregoing evidence clearly establishes that the Beneficiary has received nationally and internationally recognized awards for excellence in the field.
